l.i: 18 An entia vniuersalia sint aliquid extra intellectum?

main_text.l: DE hac quaestione grauis est controuersia inter Ph-
ilosophos tam veteres quam recentiores. Alii enim
thesin negantem; alii affirmantem defendunt. Rationes
pro thesi negante sunt duae praecipuae.
1, Quia omne ens
quod extra intellectum in natura vere & positiue exiftit,
est ens singulare. Idcirco etiam Boetius inquit: O-
mne quod est, eo ipso quod est, singulare est.
2, Quia entia vniuersalia
nihil aliud sunt, quam nugra [?] entia rationis quip-
pe quae sola mentis cogitatione ab entibus singularibus
abstrahuntur & citra illam nihil sunt.
Rationes pro thesi affirmate sunt quinque praecipuae:
1, Quia entia vniuersalia reipsa sunt in suis singularibu-
s, & extra ea non reperiuntur, vt patet ex praecedente qua-
estione. Ergo cum entia singularia extra intellectum ve-
re & positiue in natura exiftant, sequitur idem de vniuer-
salibus non posse negari.
2, Quia entia vniuersalia vere
& essentialiter praedicantur de suis singularibus. Ergo
cum [illegible, ~6 letters] aliquo [?] requirat ineffe [?]; & modus praedicandi
sequatur modum essendi; necesse est, vt entia vniuer-
salia vere & essentialiter insint suis singularibus, &, per
consequens, aliqua sint extra intellectum.
3, Quia [?] dantur in intellectu conceptus non tantum
singulares, sed etiam vniuersales. Ergo sicut conceptus
singulares sunt signa & simulachra rerum singularium;
ita etiam conceptus vniuersales sunt signa & simulachra
rerum vniuersalium extra intellectum existentium.

page.notes: Scan is clear except for the following. "nugra" in the second Ratio of the negative side is uncertain; it may be "magis" [?]. The first word of the second argument in the affirmative side (the "Quia" after "3,") has a damaged initial letter. The argument "Ergo cum ... requirat ineffe" is badly damaged and only partly legible; its first word is illegible and "aliquo" and "ineffe" are doubtful. The first numeral of the first negative Ratio is read as "1," in the text and "I." in the margin. The margin notes are read as printed; "P·o" is read as "Pro" (damaged initial). The word "Rationes" in the heading line of the affirmative side is printed "Rationes" and is kept as printed. The heading "18 An entia..." is treated as a level-2 heading (question title). Printed hyphens at line ends are kept (dif-ferre, vni-uerfale, Phi-losophos, vniuer-falibus). The Google watermark at bottom right is excluded.
